nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 68 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 19 MHz; phase margin of at least 54 degrees; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 150 ns; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 530 nV/sqrt(Hz); CMRR at low frequency of at least 73 dB.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 75 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 26 MHz; phase margin of at least 66 degrees; slew rate of at least 17 MV/s; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 260 nV/sqrt(Hz); total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 380 uW; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 67 dB; output swing of at least 1.52 V; CMRR at low frequency of at least 50 dB; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 32 ns.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 38 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 18 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 110 uW; output swing of at least 1.57 V; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 220 nV/sqrt(Hz); CMRR at low frequency of at least 57 dB; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 37 dB.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 71 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 8.4 MHz; phase margin of at least 50 degrees; output swing of at least 1.09 V; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 210 nV/sqrt(Hz); slew rate of at least 5.2 MV/s. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 21 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 26 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 480 uW; output swing of at least 1.09 V; gain-bandwidth product of at least 560 MHz; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 32 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 4.7 MHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 260 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 210 uW; output swing of at least 1.05 V; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a transimpedance amplifier for a photodiode front-end in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 200 fF; photodiode capacitance 500 fF. Requirements: transimpedance gain of at least 111 dB-ohm; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 36 MHz; input-referred noise current density at 1 MHz of at most 290 fA/sqrt(Hz); total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 60 uW; output DC level between 0.3 V and 1.5 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 1.5 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 1.2 Mohm; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.16 V.
